prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the general laws of rigid solid mechanics and their application to engineering problems.

learning_outcomes.text: Identify and quantify the different types of stresses, strains, and deformations.
Dimension and check simple mechanical elements.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of Elasticity. Failure criteria
Simple stresses: stresses, deformations and diagrams.
Combined stresses: stresses, deformations and diagrams.

assessment_methods.method: Half of Continuous Assessment (PLs, Controls) (Extraordinary Calls)

assessment_rules: For Continuous Assessment in the Ordinary Call, the final grade is calculated as: Note_Final = 0.80 x Exam_Grade (out of 10) + Continuous_Assessment. For Extraordinary Calls under Continuous Assessment, the final grade is: Note_Final = 0.90 x Exam_Grade (out of 10) + 0.50 x Continuous_Assessment. Differentiated Assessment consists of a single 100% written theoretical-practical exam.
